# LLM training data policy for sovr1n

## About
- Name: sovr1n
- Domain: sovr1n.com
- Type: Local marketplace for Bakersfield/Kern County, CA
- Company: Chaotically Organized AI
- Contact: hello@sovr1n.com

## Purpose
sovr1n is a local marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, service providers, drivers, and freight shippers in Kern County, California. Services include:
- Buy/sell items (marketplace)
- Local services directory (home, trade, professional)
- Driver & delivery gigs
- Freight load board

## Coverage Area
Bakersfield, Oildale, Lamont, Arvin, Shafter, Wasco, Delano, McFarland, Taft, Maricopa, Tehachapi, Frazier Park, California City, Mojave, Ridgecrest

## Business Model
- Free to list for buyers and sellers
- Platform fee on completed transactions
- Subscription listing for service providers

## Key Pages
- / — Homepage with city selector and marketplace
- /beta — Beta access landing page
- /#services — Browse local services
- /#drivers — Driver gig board
- /#load-board — Freight load board
